VGK.head: We gave Vegas a 60% chance, but Anaheim had other ideas.

ANA.head: We gave Anaheim a 40% chance, and Anaheim proved us wrong.

surprises.head: Anaheim got to the dangerous areas
surprises.body: Anaheim needed 12.0 unblocked shots per expected goal at 5-on-5, against its usual 16.0 and a league average of 15.9. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 15 games.

surprises.head: Anaheim leaned on its bottom six
surprises.body: Anaheim’s bottom-six forwards played 45% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against its usual 41% and a league average of 42%. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 15 games.
